vb_textbox.text: (The way I did it:) - Test each of the gnomes - then stick with the one that gives >5 mushrooms until it flips. If one gnome gives 3/4 or less, you should switch to the other colour next time. Noticing a pattern, I believe all gnomes of the same height take turns being the one giving the most mushrooms (ie. tall gnomes give more, then it randomly swaps and its the shorter ones). If you find this to be not true during the game though, feel free to ignore that last bit.
